profile.name: Md. Rakib Trofder
profile.headline: Lecturer, Department of Computer Science and Engineering

affiliation.name: Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology

profile.summary: I teach computer science at BAUST and build software. Before joining academia I spent two years as a software engineer working on microservices, AI agents, CI/CD and geospatial data systems. Now I bring that industry experience into the classroom while researching software engineering and AI for my M.Sc. at RUET.

items.company: Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology
responsibilities: Conducting lectures and laboratory sessions for undergraduate courses at CSE department and other non-departmental courses.
Mentoring students in research projects and academic development.
Developed microservice-based web application for monitoring and evaluation systems using Angular, ASP.NET, and Python.
Developed end-to-end AI agent solutions leveraging the Gemini API.
Restructured on-prem server infrastructure and implemented a fully automated CI/CD pipeline.
Architected data infrastructure for geospatial data and processed large-scale satellite datasets for agro decision-making.
Designed and built an in-house social media platform from prototype to deployment.
Completed intensive training in core web development.
Analyzed and reconstructed existing software structures to create detailed datasets.
Evaluated performance of reconstruction tools and studied limitations of LLMs in software reconstruction.
Developed a front-end project using Vue.js, implementing responsive components and state management.
Integrated REST APIs with HTTP Basic authentication to ensure secure data exchange between the client and server.
